principle: FATE is the first customer; SCUMM is the product.

entries.region: v5 reset defaults, opcode dispatch, scheduler, variables, actors, objects, room lifecycle and iMUSE hook operation contracts
entries.coupling: SCUMM v5 operations/defaults exercised by FATE
entries.why: These are reusable language/runtime contracts, not facts about a Fate room or script; the hook operand shape depends on generic hook class.
entries.current_consumer: SAME host engine and native SCUMM VM
entries.desired_destination: SCUMM IR operations and generic runtime primitives
entries.migration_action: Keep both engines as oracle/implementation; add generic and differential fixtures before changing representation.

entries.region: object hit testing, authored verb selection, sentence publication and talk/input edge ownership
entries.coupling: Controller actions resolve from active room metadata and generic input lifecycle
entries.why: The ordinary controller-ready path does not require a Fate room/object identity.
entries.current_consumer: SCUMM controller runtime and SAME input service
entries.desired_destination: Generic interaction runtime using compiler-emitted verb metadata
entries.migration_action: Preserve native edge-ownership controls; emit static verb records from compiler output.

entries.region: v5 encrypted indices/containers and stable logical resource keys
entries.coupling: Container layout, resource kinds, source directory offsets
entries.why: Archive structure and resource identities can be parsed and validated before ROM execution.
entries.current_consumer: Host raw-resource adapter, cookers and integration validators
entries.desired_destination: SCUMM front-end resource catalog with provenance
entries.migration_action: Add target-neutral resource records while retaining the current provider API as an adapter.

entries.region: LFLF/ROOM, OBCD/CDHD, object geometry, verb offsets and walkboxes
entries.coupling: Static room/object facts and source offsets
entries.why: These are authored source data; mutable owner/state/class and actor placement remain runtime state.
entries.current_consumer: Host room adapter and source cooker
entries.desired_destination: RoomIR/ObjectIR/VerbEntry front-end records
entries.migration_action: Existing checked parser results now feed the room compiler IR; migrate remaining cooker/host table consumers incrementally.

entries.region: Source-bound RoomIR/ScriptIR, v5 opcode-family/operand schema, independent structural/semantic statuses, dependency/capability report, and SC5C backend handoff
entries.coupling: Compiler-derived room, script, object/verb, and source-provenance facts
entries.why: The compiler uses dialect/resource structure and literal source operands only; FATE identities occur only in optional integration expectations, not compiler semantics.
entries.current_consumer: Room cooker, whole-game analyzer, existing stable SNES selector generator, host resource runtime
entries.desired_destination: Generic SCUMM front end and analysis feeding the SNES backend
entries.migration_action: Extend only source-verified v5 structural forms; keep structural decoding independent from semantic/runtime certification and preserve opaque boundaries for unproven encodings.

entries.region: Source catalog, canonical executable/resource graph, conservative reachability, capability registry and unsupported frontier
entries.coupling: Edition-neutral graph/capability analysis over source identities; no selectors or title constants
entries.why: All graph relations come from the generic source catalog and shared room/script IR. FATE expectations are isolated in optional tests/profile inputs.
entries.current_consumer: SCUMM game-analysis CLI and optional integration acceptance
entries.desired_destination: Generic SCUMM front end/analysis before SNES backend manifest generation
entries.migration_action: Preserve unknown/opaque/dynamic uncertainty; extend generic decoder/resource coverage and independently validate runtime support.

entries.region: Source-scope lifetime classification, room/global partition demand, staged room transitions and selector-capacity estimates
entries.coupling: Compiler derives executable scope and dependency lifetimes; runtime slot and backend selector limits are generic target facts
entries.why: The planner consumes canonical SCUMM identities and generic dependency edges, does not allocate selectors, and contains no title-specific identities.
entries.current_consumer: Whole-game analysis output and backend architecture planning
entries.desired_destination: Compiler analysis and later backend residency manifest
entries.migration_action: Keep working-set epistemic labels explicit; use the report to specify a resolver/pinning contract before changing runtime selector ABI.

entries.region: SC5C/SC5VIS records, provenance hashes and executable directories
entries.coupling: Deterministic cooked records derived from source/profile inputs
entries.why: These are useful compiler artifacts/interchange, but are not canonical semantic IR.
entries.current_consumer: Host provider, SNES generators and runtime resource lookup
entries.desired_destination: Versioned compiler artifact schemas fed by analyzed IR
entries.migration_action: Preserve schemas first; change producers to consume typed analysis results.

entries.region: ProgramIdAllocator and executable table/directory emission
entries.coupling: Source executable identity to native selector and target layout
entries.why: Selection inputs are source identities; selector allocation and bank placement are reproducible backend outputs.
entries.current_consumer: Native M23A directory and script dispatch
entries.desired_destination: SNES backend layout pass over analyzed executable identities
entries.migration_action: Keep stable allocator/IDs; separate dependency selection from allocation and placement.

entries.region: MAXS/source capacities to WRAM symbols and layout manifest
entries.coupling: Source limits plus target memory capacity
entries.why: Source-derived counts and SNES address constraints are distinguishable inputs.
entries.current_consumer: Poppy assembly and memory audits
entries.desired_destination: GameIR source limits plus backend WRAM layout report
entries.migration_action: Represent MAXS facts in IR; retain addresses/overflow checks in backend.

entries.region: Source decoding and bank-safe visual/font/costume output
entries.coupling: Source codecs/geometry/palettes versus target packing
entries.why: Format parsing is front-end work; SNES row/palette/bank packing is backend work.
entries.current_consumer: Host presentation tests and native rendering services
entries.desired_destination: SCUMM visual IR and SNES backend converters
entries.migration_action: Separate decoded source records from target-packed assets and report codec capabilities.

entries.region: Encoded text controls, charset records and generated glyph tables
entries.coupling: Source strings/glyphs and target text storage
entries.why: Text/control and glyph facts derive from source; storage/packing is backend policy.
entries.current_consumer: SCUMM message runtime and SNES text service
entries.desired_destination: StringIR/CharsetIR then text backend
entries.migration_action: Keep raw controls/source spans and pack immutable glyph data offline.

entries.region: Embedded MIDI/iMUSE SysEx event vocabulary and payload decoding
entries.coupling: Source audio event grammar, vendor messages and encoded instrument/jump/marker operands
entries.why: This is a bounded source-format decoder; its supported event subset should become explicit front-end capability data, not a title-specific opcode rule.
entries.current_consumer: Host embedded-audio adapter and source music importers
entries.desired_destination: SCUMM audio front end / SoundIR event sequence
entries.migration_action: Retain raw spans and report unknown/vendor-specific event coverage; keep playback realization outside the parser.

entries.region: Edition/game IDs, archive keys, title policy, resource templates, audio settings and selected script sets
entries.coupling: Fate edition and content choices
entries.why: These facts choose title/edition/content; they do not define SCUMM semantics.
entries.current_consumer: Profile loader, raw provider, cookers and build scripts
entries.desired_destination: Thin source-edition profile plus generated build manifest
entries.migration_action: Keep edition/archive facts; move derived closure and target gates into analysis output.

entries.region: SAME_BUILD_SCUMM_PHASE6*, SAME_SCUMM_APPEND_* and profile-owned script sets
entries.coupling: Explicitly selected Fate rooms and executable closure
entries.why: Which content to package is title/build policy; parsing and allocation mechanisms remain generic.
entries.current_consumer: FATE native builds and executable selector tables
entries.desired_destination: Analyzed build plan with explicit roots for diagnostics
entries.migration_action: Retain overrides; derive direct-reference closure incrementally.

entries.region: Fate-specific logical sound 80/82 composite mapping and title audio builds
entries.coupling: Title-specific audio import/content and composite realization policy
entries.why: The sound 80/82 pairing and bounded composite realization are Fate content policy, not generic sound-opcode semantics.
entries.current_consumer: Embedded audio adapter, optional title music builds and profile mappings
entries.desired_destination: Generic music/audio IR plus title profile and backend realization
entries.migration_action: Move sound-ID pairing out of generic runtime code; keep title converters at the import edge.

entries.region: SAME_BUILD_SCUMM_SCENARIO_FIXTURE / SAME_SCUMM_SCENARIO_SOURCE_ACTOR_STATE actor-2/room-42 setup and reconciliation
entries.coupling: Fixture source-root construction references room 42 and source actor placement
entries.why: It is controlled setup/repair, not an opcode rule or ordinary room lifecycle contract.
entries.current_consumer: Selected native scenario-fixture builds
entries.desired_destination: Explicit fixture bootstrap resource/profile or retired hook
entries.migration_action: Keep isolated; retire only after an equivalent source-driven fixture exists.

entries.region: SAME_BUILD_SCUMM_CONTROLLER_FIXTURE room-68 acknowledgement/request to room 42 and source-string seeding
entries.coupling: Specific demo bootstrap and prerequisites for controller scenario
entries.why: These branches prepare a bounded scenario; ordinary interaction code resolves active room metadata.
entries.current_consumer: Native controller scenario fixture only
entries.desired_destination: Separate synthetic bootstrap driver/resource
entries.migration_action: Keep compiled out of non-fixture builds; do not generalize room identities into runtime policy.

entries.path: examples/replays/fate-room4-open-trapdoor.json; tools/fate_replay.py; src/same/engines/scumm_v5/engine.py comments on checkpoint state
entries.region: Room4-7 inputs, cursor coordinates, object/verb tuples, expected transitions and observed game-state values such as VAR_CHARINC at a named checkpoint
entries.coupling: Concrete game-specific replay steps and authored/source-state expectations
entries.why: These are acceptance inputs and checkpoint observations, not engine defaults or language semantics.
entries.current_consumer: Deterministic host/fake and native FATE replay
entries.desired_destination: Declarative FATE integration corpus with pre/postconditions
entries.migration_action: Retain source/ROM provenance; do not convert checkpoint values into production initialization.

entries.region: FATE resource offsets/body hashes/object verbs and selector assertions
entries.coupling: Specific source/ROM acceptance checks
entries.why: These identities deliberately fail closed when the reviewed source/build changes.
entries.current_consumer: FATE acceptance tooling
entries.desired_destination: Source manifest plus generic validator assertions
entries.migration_action: Keep identities bound to archive/ROM; derive selector assertions from compiler maps where possible.

entries.region: Synthetic scripts, test room/object IDs and ROM assertions
entries.coupling: Copyright-free conformance content and acceptance machinery
entries.why: Fixture IDs/bytes are selected for tests, not inherited from Fate.
entries.current_consumer: Host tests and bounded native conformance ROMs
entries.desired_destination: Layered semantic fixtures and tiny compiled fixture game
entries.migration_action: Keep independent of FATE and route through future front-end/IR/backend path.

entries.region: Compile-time M23C object 595/class/sound-82 preflight controls and controller room-42 visual witness
entries.coupling: Title-derived state used as inputs to bounded profile/conformance builds
entries.why: These branches are selected test personalities with explicit source/profile setup, not ordinary script semantics.
entries.current_consumer: Bounded M23C/M24R-B and controller native controls
entries.desired_destination: Fixture/profile data consumed by generic conformance setup
entries.migration_action: Keep the test state declarative and compile-gated; avoid moving these IDs into normal engine paths.

entries.region: Room-7 bit69, objects 118/119, verbs and local-script progression observations
entries.coupling: Authored integration findings in documentation
entries.why: These facts explain an observed FATE path, not a SCUMM rule.
entries.current_consumer: Future FATE integration/replay work
entries.desired_destination: FATE source manifest and integration corpus
entries.migration_action: Preserve scope/provenance; treat the old ledger as historical evidence.

scope_note: Grouped high-value couplings, not every numeric literal. Compile-gated runtime fixture hooks are distinguished from replay/test identities.
